units.source_text: 神甫知道这件事后，某一天，叫罗连到自己屋内，委婉的对他说：

en.t: After the priest learned of this matter, one day he called Lorenzo into his room and spoke to him gently:

units.source_text: “外面有传言说你和伞铺的女儿行为不检，这件事是否属实？”

en.t: There are rumors outside that you and the umbrella shop owner's daughter have behaved improperly. Is this true?

units.source_text: 罗连满脸愁云，连连摇头，一边哽咽，一边再三声称：

en.t: Lorenzo's face was clouded with sorrow; he shook his head again and again, and while sobbing, repeatedly insisted:

units.source_text: 神甫认为他年龄还小，平时信仰坚定，知道他绝对不会说谎，于是相信了他。

en.t: The priest thought he was still young and had always been firm in his faith, and knowing that he would never lie, he believed him.
